# Re-fetch the current queue and all liked songs to ensure we have the latest data.
access_token = login_result['access_token']

# Fetch all liked songs (paginate)
liked_songs_all = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    liked_songs_all.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Fetch current queue
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)

print("Liked songs count:", len(liked_songs_all))
print("Queue count:", len(queue))
print("Queue positions and song_ids:")
for song in queue:
    print(song['position'], song['song_id'], song['title'])

steps.code:
# Identify positions of liked songs in the queue
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs_all}
positions_to_remove = [song['position'] for song in queue if song['song_id'] in liked_ids]
print("Positions to remove:", positions_to_remove)

# Remove from highest to lowest to avoid index shifting
for pos in sorted(positions_to_remove, reverse=True):
    result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(access_token=access_token, position=pos)
    print(f"Removed position {pos}: {result}")
